changelog.notes: Photos: a folder of pictures opens as a grid instead of a list, any of them fills the screen, and the arrows page through the folder. OK enlarges a photo and the arrows then move around inside it. Photos can also be sent straight from a phone: pick 'From your phone', scan the code, and they appear on the TV.

The review round: the cursor comes back after ejecting a stick, a box whose software is too old says so instead of showing a spinner, and two films ending at once cannot lose each other's resume point.
Play films and music from the box's own folders or from a USB stick, with resume and subtitle selection.

description.en: Everything the box already has, on the TV: films and music from your own folders (anything you copy in over the file server) and from USB sticks, which are mounted when you open them and ejected from the same screen. Remembers where each film got to, and lets you switch audio track and subtitles while watching. Photos open as a grid you can page through full-screen and zoom into, and you can send some straight from your phone by scanning a code.
description.hu: Minden, ami a boxon van, a TV-n: filmek és zene a saját mappáidból (bármi, amit a fájlkiszolgálón átmásolsz) és USB-kulcsokról, amelyeket megnyitáskor csatol, és ugyanonnan ki is adhatsz. Megjegyzi, hol tartottál egy filmben, és nézés közben válthatsz hangsávot vagy feliratot. A képek rácsban nyílnak meg, teljes képernyőn lapozhatók és nagyíthatók, és egy kód beolvasásával a telefonodról is küldhetsz párat.
